long_biography.plain_text:
An education at Winchester College and a career in London investment banking placed Iglesias inside international property finance. He began in real-estate investment at Merrill Lynch, became a managing director at Morgan Stanley and later led European real-estate acquisitions at J.P. Morgan Asset Management. Those roles gave him the institutional network and transaction experience to launch Drago in 2001.

From Madrid, Iglesias built Drago as an independent investment and management platform for Spanish and Portuguese property. The firm attracted international capital for large acquisitions, including Banco Santander's branch portfolio, before extending its model into active redevelopment. Its work has covered offices, housing, shops, hotels and logistics, often converting complex urban assets to new uses. Iglesias remains founding partner and chief executive, combining capital raising, acquisitions and asset management with long-term control of the firm.
